QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 7 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew needs you to drive the Grays off, since they weren't invited, but be nice enough that they'll still register as Democrats.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Speaking Hall and drive off the Zeno!
QuestInfo.2: Zeno and his crew are no more. Return to Stew.
